name: The Level
description: One of the city's largest play areas, with seasonal water play. The council is replacing all of the old equipment with a new inclusive adventure playground for all ages and abilities: the play area was fenced off from 7 September 2026 for around 10 weeks, so check it has reopened before you go. The café kiosk and skatepark stay open.
